coverage_override.reason: The send-self cost, temporary control, and type changes form one Chain-Link-3 Quick Effect; Chain-Link-5 and Scarstech activation are alternative conditions of one GY self-Summon effect.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 3 or higher (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; take control of 1 monster your opponent controls until the End Phase, also it becomes a DARK Galaxy monster.
effects.lua_implementation: The EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect with id HOPT now has range LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_MZONE+LOCATION_SZONE, so this original Monster Card can activate from either printed source. It requires current chain at least 3, sends itself to the GY as cost, non-target-selects a changeable opposing monster, takes control through the End Phase, and applies End-Phase-reset DARK attribute and Galaxy race changes. Target legality correctly accounts for a freed Monster Zone only when the handler began in MZONE.

official_references.matched_structure: Official EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect checks Duel.GetCurrentChain()>2 for Chain Link 3 or higher.
Official Monster Card cost filter accepts original Monster Cards across LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_ONFIELD and sends the selected card to the GY as cost.
Official effect takes control of one opponent monster until the End Phase with Duel.GetControl.

effects.issue: Fixed: the activation range now includes LOCATION_SZONE, so an on-field Scarstech Invader treated as a Spell/Trap can pay the printed 'hand or field' self-send cost.

effects.printed_clause: When a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 5 or higher, or when a "Scarstech" card or effect is activated while this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY EVENT_CHAINING Quick Effect with id+100 accepts Duel.GetCurrentChain()>=5 or an activating handler with the Scarstech set code, excluding this handler itself. Target and operation both enforce Monster Zone capacity, Necrovalley, relatedness, and self-Summon legality before reviving it.

official_references.matched_structure: Official chain-sensitive effect uses Duel.GetCurrentChain()>=5 to recognize Chain Link 5 or higher.
Official GY effect checks summon legality and Necrovalley before Special Summoning its handler.
